_about: Pinterest pin queue. Marketing writes pins, security reviews them, Mark approves by merging. A daily GitHub Action (scripts/build-pin-feeds.mjs) adds each pin to its board's RSS feed on or after its publish date, at most one per board per day (earliest date first), so late merges don't post all at once; Pinterest then posts it. Links must be thepartywheel.com URLs using only the pages' own preset parameters. No # share links, no shorteners. Never reuse a posted pin's id.

holiday.title: The Party Wheel: Holiday party ideas

pins.title: Holiday Game Night for 8 to 12 People: Spin for a Game
pins.description: Hosting Friendsmas or a family holiday get-together? Spin a free wheel of 17 holiday party games for groups of 8 to 12, mixing no-supply games like Charades and Holiday Trivia with card games like Wavelength, Herd Mentality, and Monikers, plus a White Elephant gift swap. Each spin shows quick rules and a link to how-to-play videos. Free, no sign-up.

pins.title: Family Christmas Movie Night: Spin to Pick a Movie
pins.description: Can't agree on a family Christmas movie? Spin a free wheel of kid-friendly picks like Elf, Home Alone, Klaus, The Polar Express, and Arthur Christmas. No PG-13 or R picks, and each pick shows where to stream it. Free, no sign-up.

pins.title: White Elephant Gifts for a $25 Limit: Spin for One
pins.description: Office gift exchange with a $20 or $25 limit? Spin for practical white elephant ideas that usually cost $10 to $25: a sherpa throw blanket, an insulated tumbler, a portable phone charger, a mini waffle maker, a hot sauce sampler, and more. Prices vary, so check before you buy. Each idea links to shop it. Free, no sign-up.
